preconditions.expression: len(s) == len(t) and s < t and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Input consists of two lowercase strings s and t of equal length, where s is lexicographically smaller than t.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No such string' or (all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdout) and len(stdout) == len(s) and s < stdout < t)
postconditions.description: If no valid string exists, output is 'No such string'. Otherwise, output is a string of the same length as s and t, lexicographically between s and t, consisting of lowercase letters.
